title: Network checklist carousels and decision-path diagrams for private onboarding
creator: Aisha Rodríguez
description: Design a compact, tile-based onboarding checklist presented as a carousel for Private/VPC first-run users, accompanied by decision-path diagrams that surface branching install flows (airgap vs cloud-provisioned vs operator-managed). Deliverables include high-fidelity carousel screens, three microcopy variants for each tile state, an animated upgrade modal that explains compatibility and rollback options, and a condensed PDF flowchart for support and sales. Emphasis on progressive disclosure: surface only next actionable step, allow experienced users to expand the full flow. Goal is to reduce time-to-first-successful-connect by 30% in our initial pilot customers.
acceptance_criteria: Carousel UI: 5 tiles covering prerequisites, network config, credentials, bootstrap, verification; each tile has collapsed/expanded states and inline help
Decision-path diagrams: Vector SVGs for 3 major install scenarios (airgap, VPC with shared services, operator-managed on-prem) with clear branching labels
Upgrade modal: shows compatibility matrix, estimated downtime, one-click rollback CTA; includes microcopy variants A/B tested
Assets: Figma file with named frames, exportable PNG + SVG assets, and a compact PDF flowchart for support
UX copy: three microcopy variants and annotated guidance for localization team
Developer handoff: tokens and spacing defined in a single page spec; responsive behavior documented for 1280px, 1024px, and 768px widths
tasks: Draft initial tile content and 3 microcopy variants
Create decision-path sketches and align with infrastructure team
Design animated upgrade modal + rollback confirmation
Export SVGs and build compact PDF flowchart
Prepare developer spec: components, tokens, animation timings
Accessibility pass: color contrast and keyboard nav
